supers.text: Everything down here has to come out tonight.
The old way: estimate tomorrow. Contract next week. Crew waits.
A priced pack-out estimate, before you leave the house.
Signed on site. No printer. No second trip.
The signed copy lands in both inboxes. Automatically.
Priced, signed, and packing before dark.
